evidence.observedFact: The active booking profile publishes current Painesville hours and requires a card on file; cancellations or reschedules inside 48 hours are charged 50%, no-shows are charged 100%, and unpaid declined-card invoices must be resolved before another appointment can be booked.
The business currently offers online booking for multiple facial services, including a dedicated New Client Facial + Consultation, confirming an active appointment-driven acquisition flow.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate cancellation recovery, rebooking reminders and permissioned waitlist/backfill workflows around appointment inventory.
Create a permissioned new-client-to-repeat-client journey with timely rebooking and comeback rewards after completed or disrupted appointments.

recommendedEntryOffer: Cancellation Recovery + Client Reactivation Revenue Engine
notes: The published cancellation rules are observed facts. The proposed reactivation workflow is a sales hypothesis and does not imply that GlowHaus lacks existing retention processes or has a quantified revenue loss. No publicContact is included because a general business email or phone was not verified from a business-published source during this observation.
